title: HSLDA - Videos
description:
Advocates for Homeschooling.

Home School Legal Defense Association (HSLDA) is a national nonprofit with almost 100,000 member families. Our ultimate goal is to give homeschooling families peace of mind so they can focus on crafting the educational experience that best fits each child.
